Values: {condition: "single interval", value: -50, unit: "%"}, {condition: "multi-interval", value: "-(Max1-e1)"}. Hmm, the second is a formula. Let me put it in config_level: attribute "tare_limit", axis "weighing_range_type".
- Temperature range: 0 °C / +40 °C → {min: 0, max: 40}, unit °C
- Power supply voltage: 5 V DC through external AC/DC adapter, or 4.5 V DC through 3 AA batteries or rechargeable battery → this varies by power source. Or type_level as list. Better config_level: attribute "power_supply_voltage", axis "power_source".

- Software identification: Version number d1.01.4 → string value "d1.01.4"

Also note: 4,5 V → 4.5 decimal conversion.

I'll not include model_family, but type_designations: ["PS1X.. series"] or ["PS1X"]. Hmm, "PS1X.. series" — the ".." indicates placeholder digits. I'll record type_designations: ["PS1X.. series"].
